coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 4 of 6 ground-truth variable categories (67%): shared architecture within each paired comparison, fixed training settings, standard versus fused Adam implementations, and graph complexity measured using node/edge counts and grouping-related metrics.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omniglot and other standard meta-learning datasets are not specified. TorchViz versus TorchOpt is not treated as the independent visualization-tool comparison; instead, torch.fx is the primary graph capture tool and TorchViz is secondary. The additional model classes and emphasis on functional rather than gradient graphs also depart from the intended experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that operation fusion reduces gradient graph complexity, yielding fewer nodes and simpler visualizations when comparing TorchOpt to TorchViz.
